“Hey, you alright?” a voice called from behind her, breaking the spell. Startled, she turned to see Mark, his brow creased with concern, hands shoved deep into the pockets of his worn jeans.

“Just thinking,” she replied, forcing a smile, but the words felt heavy on her tongue. It was a simple enough answer, but it didn’t capture the whirlpool of emotions swirling in her chest, the uncertainty that had settled like a fog over her thoughts.

“Not really,” she murmured, biting the inside of her cheek.
